comparison.objective: Insert a circuit board into an antistatic bag and place the bag in a crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold open/stabilize a compliant bag while feeding a flat rigid board into its cavity.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully inside near the closed end; bag released flat inside the crate; neither item dropped.
comparison.reason: The record tests rigid-into-compliant insertion and packaging. It shares only generic alignment and bimanual stabilization with the candidate.
